faqs.q: How long does a new fiber connection installation take?
faqs.a: Once your connection request is confirmed, our certified field technicians usually install, splice the fiber optical cable, and activate your high-speed internet within 24 to 48 hours.

faqs.q: What does a Red LOS light on my ONU/router indicate?
faqs.a: A red LOS (Loss of Signal) light indicates that the optical fiber cable is not receiving a laser signal. Check that the yellow patch cord is securely plugged into the bottom of your router without sharp bends. If it remains red, please file a support ticket or WhatsApp us so our lineman can check the outdoor optical splice.

faqs.q: Can I upgrade or downgrade my package at any time?
faqs.a: Yes! Package changes take effect immediately or on the first day of your next billing cycle with zero administrative fees. Simply contact our support desk or send a request.

faqs.q: What happens if there is an area power outage (load-shedding)?
faqs.a: Our core aggregation nodes and distribution distribution points are backed up with industrial battery banks and generator systems. If you power your home router with a small DC mini-UPS, your fiber connection continues working uninterrupted during outages.

faqs.q: How do I retrieve my Customer ID / Account Number?
faqs.a: Your Customer ID is printed on your monthly payment receipt, provided in your welcome SMS/WhatsApp message, or you can look it up instantly using your registered mobile phone number in our Bill Lookup tab.
